diagnosis: The uvicorn fallback in the shutdown watcher copied a server-scoped should_exit flag into process-global AppStatus.should_exit, which was never reset. A later stream then saw the latched global flag and exited. The watcher also held onto a server resolved only once, so it could outlive that server and affect a later one. The fix re-resolves the server on each poll and no longer copies the server flag into the global state.
label_note: Curated from issue #211 and merged PR #212. The PR documents two related watcher defects and adds a focused regression test. Never pass this file to the agents.
evaluation_note: Opened September 27, 2026, after the model card's stated January 4, 2026 cutoff, but that date alone does not prove exclusion from training or tuning. The issue already names AppStatus.should_exit and explains the shutdown-watcher state leak, so this is a diagnosis-revealing smoke case, not blind-localization evidence.
